notes.title: Notice
notes.notes:
Dear players,
  
   

We regret to inform you that we will have to close all the servers of Legend of Long Night from 12:00 am on 3rd June, 2019. 
It was hard to come to this decision. We will do our best to offer you the gaming experience before it is closing. Meanwhile, we will also continue developing the games with high-quality. 

Thank you for all your support of Legend of Long Night. We have really enjoyed playing with all of you over the years, and believe that everything happened in Legend of Long Night will become the good memories in our life. 


Thank you!
Locojoy Games

notes.title: Legend of Long Night Is Free To Play Soon.
notes.notes:
Do you have experienced Legend of Long Night and want to enjoy it with your friends? Did you wanna play this pure RTS game but haven't bought it? Now, as you can see, you can download Legend of Long Night for FREE soon!
If you have bought Legend of Long Night, please login and receive the gold in your mailbox we prepare for you.
Purchase Legend of Long Night recently? Refunds will be provided by Steam in accordance with its refund policy. Please contact Steam customer service with any questions about refunds.

notes.title: Free game soon
notes.notes:
Dear players,

To let more players experience the game, we decide to turn it to be a freemium game soon.

It will not affect any player who have downloaded or will download the game, since the game becomes freemium.

Thank you for all your support of the game.

notes.title: Server Off for Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Legend of Long Night servers will be temporarily unavailable due to the release of an update.

Schedule: From 2:00-3:00, 11/05/2018 (PDT) 
Way: Server Shut Down (Players need to log in to Steam and download the update after the maintenance. The update pack is about 390MB. )
Range: All Servers
Update Contents:
Optimizations
1.	Optimized mine regeneration rules.
2.	You can now drag the Attack and Defense function icons to designated places.
3.	Added adjustment button for music and sound effects in settings.

Bugfixes
1.	Fixed the ranking data error.
2.	Fixed the abnormal display when opening Decks.
3.	Removed noises from sound effects.
4.	Solved the problem of being unable to acquire some of the achievements on Steam.
5.	Other slight adjustments and fixes.

For more details, please visit our Steam Store Page!

We are a company focused on developing fun and creative games. If you have encountered any inconveniences and problems, please leave your comments and suggestions by clicking the GM button on the bottom right corner of the home screen. We’d like to hear your feedback about the game. You are also welcomed to check out our official Facebook page: Legend of Long Night

Thank you!
Locojoy Games

notes.title: Game Update: New Modes and Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We will perform a server shut down to update with new content and a number of improvements.

Schedule:  From 14:00-15:00, 01/05/2018 (PTD)
Way: Server Shut Down (Players need to log in Steam and download the update after the maintenance. The update pack is about 390MB. )
Range: All Servers
New Contents:
1.	Casual Mode Available Now
Casual is a 15 minute PvP combat mode randomly matching you with opponents from all over the world. Construction and troop productions are accelerated and hero attributes enhanced for a fast match. Choose from 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 multiplayer modes. You don’t just have to fight the AI, invite your friends to a match and gang up or fight against each other. Statistics from this mode do not count towards your rankings. 

2.	Competition Mode Available Now
Competition is a 60 minute classic PvP mode. To win you need to collect resources, produce units and destroy your enemies base. You will have the chance to compete with players from all over the world. Matchups will count on your battle results and arena level. Competition mode only opens from 20:00 to 22:00 PDT every day. Results in this mode determine your rankings in the ranking list. 

3.	Adventure Mode Optimization
According to players’ feedback, we’ve reduced the difficulty in Besieged Temple, Gnome Defense Battle and Final Strike Back.

4.	Survival Mode Optimization
We’ve removed Nazgul King, Light Priest and Gnome Doctor which influence the game balance in this mode based on players’ feedback. 

5.	Other Adjustments and Bugfixes
Fixed the failure of defensive components upgrading in Training Ground and Adventure. 
Added failure notices that are missing in some stages in Adventure.
Rearranged some of the UI displays.
Fixed some language errors.
Refined units quality in Gallery to make unit upgrading and collocation clearer. 
Integrated into Steam Achievement.
For more details, please visit our Steam Store Page!

We are a company focusing on developing fun and creative games. If you have encountered any inconveniences and problems, please leave your comments and suggestions by clicking the GM button on the bottom right corner of the home game. We’d like to hear your feedback about the game. You are also welcomed to check out our official Facebook page: Legend of Long Night

Thank you!
Locojoy Games
